{{Quote|Nik, you've got to try these honeystix! Fabulous! Feyodor's outdone himself this time.|[[Drake Paulsen]] to [[Nikaede Celso]]|<ref name="II">{{JournalCite|12|Idol Intentions}}</ref>}}
'''Rishi honeystix''' were a type of [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]]. They were dipped in sweet powder and lightly fried to give the dish a crispy batter. [[Feyodor]] cooked and served the dish at his [[Feyodor's Tavern|establishment]] in [[Capital City (Omman)|Capital City]] on [[Omman Minor]].<ref name="II" />
